parties.respondent: The Kerala Water Authority and Ors.

summary: Seniority dispute; promotion quotas under Kerala Public Health Engineering Service Special Rules, 1960 vs. Subordinate Service Rules, 1966; applicability of 'degree quota' and 'diploma quota'; option to switch quota at time of promotion; pre-promotion degree holders; 'once a mortgage, always a mortgage' principle; erroneous application of Special Rules, 1960 to Subordinate Service Rules, 1966; Chandravathi P.K. precedent cited; seniority list challenge.
legal_provisions_cited: Kerala Public Health Engineering Service Special Rules, 1960 Rule 4(b)
Kerala Public Health Engineering Subordinate Service Rules, 1966
Chandravathi P.K. and Others. vs. C.K. Saji and Others, (2004) 3 SCC 734
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; seniority of appellants restored.
